{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
data_filtered = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = data_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Confirm the number of test orders
num_test_orders = len(test_orders)

# Print results
total_revenue, num_test_orders"}
